name: Carpe Noctem
source:
Carpe Noctem is a Gothic lesbian romance inspired by Castlevania and Le Fanu's Carmilla.

This visual novel takes place in an alternate Victorian England plagued by creatures of the night. Adelaide Hadid, an orphan trained by The Church to slay monsters, is dispatched to a rural town to eliminate a powerful vampiress.

After a fateful duel with the seductive Cordelia,  Adelaide finds herself growing closer to the vampiress and her charming maid, Lily. With her life suddenly beginning to change, the monster hunter must grapple with conflicted feelings about her target and The Church...

[from [url=https://justriver.itch.io/carpenoctem]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Carpe Noctem》是一部哥特式女同性恋爱情故事，灵感来自《恶魔城》与勒法努的《卡米拉》。

这部视觉小说，发生在一个受到夜间生物侵扰的架空维多利亚时代英国。孤女阿德莱德·哈迪德自幼受教会训练，猎杀怪物，如今被派往乡间小镇，消灭一位强大的女吸血鬼。

与充满诱惑的科迪莉娅进行一场宿命对决后，阿德莱德发现，自己与女吸血鬼，以及她迷人的女仆莉莉，逐渐亲近。生活突然开始改变，这位猎魔者必须面对，自己对猎物与教会产生的矛盾感情…
